item.description:
##This is THE essential San Diego tour. You will see many of the great places that make San Diego "America's Finest City". You will also get a small sample of San Diego's culture and diversity!*

*(All GoCars Hold 2 People)*

## Duration
2 Hours

## About
This is THE essential San Diego tour. You will see almost all of the greatest sights San Diego has to offer, from the visually stunning Balboa park which is littered with Spanish Renaissance-inspired architecture, over a dozen museums, colorful flower gardens, and a world-renowned outdoor organ pavilion all the way to the always happening Hillcrest, which has a great variety of shops and restaurants, Hillcrest is known to have some of the best food in the county. But best of all you will also get to see Downtown San Diego at its finest, from the Maritime Museum to the Historic Gaslamp Quarter. Downtown San Diego is one of the best places in the world for its diversity and visual appeal. Don’t miss the best places San Diego has to offer on this Must See tour.

**Tour Highlights:**

- Little Italy
- Maritime Museum
- U.S.S. Midway
- Seaport Village
- Horton Plaza Historic Gaslamp Quarter
- Petco Park
- Bankers Hill
- Balboa Park tour
- Balboa Park Rose Graden
- San Diego Zoo
- Hillcrest neighborhood

**Conditions:**

- GoCars hold a maximum of 2 people. Prices are per GoCar, not per person.
- Must be 21 years or older to rent. Must possess a major credit card and a valid driver’s license (an international license is not necessary). GoCars do not accommodate car seats for children.
- On the day of rental, a security deposit will be held on your credit card until the GoCar is returned. All riders must sign a standard participant agreement. Renters will have the option to purchase Collision Damage Waiver (CDW) insurance on the day of rental.
- Renters are free to extend the length of their tour on the day of rental. Additional rental time will be charged in 15-minute increments."
item.booking_notes:
##Please arrive at least 15 min before your scheduled departure time. 

-Departure times are approximated due to customers prior to your reservation possibly taking longer than they were booked for.

- If you wish to keep your car longer than what you have booked for, you are welcome, but please check that it is available for you to keep and not needed by another renter. 

- Additional time is charged in 15-minute increments at our standard internet rates. 

- Please make sure you return the car before we close. Late returns are billed at $1 per minute. Please check with staff on the day of rental the close time of the location. Early returns will not be refunded for unused time.
item.cancellation_notes:
Cancellation Policy
Activity may be canceled at operators discretion due to weather conditions including heavy rain, high winds, or lightning. As safety is our top priority, weather cancellations are made on a case by case basis up to time of departure. In the rare situation the seller must cancel the event prior to departure, ticket-holders will be allowed to reschedule tickets (subject to availability), receive a gift card, or receive a full refund (including trip protection).

If an activity is cut short early due to severe weather, rainchecks will be given to all guests. Full refunds are not available after the cruise leaves the dock, but rainchecks do not expire.

Refund and Rescheduling Policy
All sales are final, unless trip protection is purchased up front. No refunds, reissue to gift cards, or rescheduling will be permitted without trip protection.

Trip Protection Policy
Trip Protection must be added at the time of purchase. Trip Protection allows for rescheduling (subject to availability) or refund of tickets up to 2 hours prior to departure time, for any reason. Refunds will reimburse for the full amount of each ticket, less the Trip Protection fees.

Trip Protection is voided and no refunds will be issued if 1) guest(s) arrive and check into the cruise, 2) guest(s) give notice of cancellation or rescheduling within 60 minute window, or 3) guest(s) are no-shows without notifying us 60 minutes prior to departure time.
